timeliness.rule: share of earlier items late or missing: 0 On time, <= some_late_max Some late, else Often late or missing

grade_map.states: P(grade >= target); courses[course][target] has one value per decile 1..10

exam_difficulty.explanation: Exam difficulty = the mean of the three parent levels (first state = 0, middle = 1, last = 2), rounded. Example: (0, 0, 1) has mean 0.33, which rounds to 0.

perf.explanation: Perf = the mean of the three parent levels (first state = 0, middle = 1, last = 2), rounded. Example: (0, 0, 1) has mean 0.33, which rounds to 0.

study_before.explanation: Level-only fallback, used when there are no timer logs. Window = 28 days. hours = pace * 27 / 7 + action hours; weekly = hours / 4; pace Low/Med/High = [1.0, 3.0, 5.0] h/week, action Intense/Light/Rest = 5/1/0 h. active days = share * 27 + 1 if the action is not Rest; share = [0.1, 0.3, 0.6] (placeholder). Weekly hours are bucketed 0/1/2 by cuts [2.0, 4.0], active days by cuts [5.4, 12.15] (placeholder); the two levels are summed: 0-1 Low, 2 Med, 3-4 High. Days left has no effect in this fallback; with timer logs the logged hours and active days replace the pace for the elapsed days and the pace covers only the remaining days.
